title: ID0426111-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / SN 170004220] Programming Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Yesterday the charger went in to this error:
Programmingerror occured inFB3002, FaultID:22PLC-FW-Version:

Child ticket ID0426340 - R&D ticket to be created by L3
